title: A sodium atom and a sodium ion
caption: Na and Na⁺ have the same nucleus, 11 protons and 12 neutrons. The ion has lost its single outer electron, so 11 positive charges and 10 negative ones leave a charge of +1.
alt: Sodium atom with shells 2, 8, 1 beside the sodium ion with shells 2, 8; both nuclei have 11 protons and 12 neutrons.
description: Left: sodium atom, nucleus 11 p and 12 n, electrons 2, 8, 1.
Right: sodium ion Na⁺, the same nucleus, electrons 2, 8; charge 11 − 10 = +1.
